timing.preflight: Normal output parity and two context determinism calls precede the one declared warmup; preflight costs are not timing samples.

metrics.inspected_nodes: Reported selected lexical scan only; excludes selector search, checker work, form_span descendant visits, provider and type work.
metrics.fact_rows: Reported emitted selected checked facts, capped at 512; omitted row totals remain unknown.
metrics.reference_rows: Reported emitted lexical reference occurrences, capped at 512; duplicates are retained.
metrics.provider_rows: Reported emitted distinct direct providers, capped at 64; provider bodies are not traversed.
metrics.source_bytes_copied: Reported original source octets copied into report strings; distinct from encoded report bytes.
metrics.report_bytes: Exact successful stdout byte length including the final newline.
metrics.fact_span_bytes_sum: Independent sum of valid reported fact source-span lengths. This overlapping source-byte metric is not a canonical-node work counter.
metrics.nested_suffix_items: Generator structural proxy n(n+1)/2 for nested continuation/expression suffixes; not observed compiler work.
metrics.native_process_seconds: Uninstrumented process wall time. The context command includes normal admission/checking/construction/output and is not retained query latency.

phase_isolation.ordinary_check: Separate measured command, never subtracted to invent context construction time.
phase_isolation.ordinary_emit: Separate measured command including checking and generated C emission.
phase_isolation.cold_context: Separate measured command including admission, checking, construction and output.
phase_isolation.total_context_node_work: unknown: inspected_nodes omits repeated form_span and provider/type work

context.source_geometry: Quadratic indentation bytes; report actual bytes separately from depth.
Quadratic indentation bytes; report actual bytes separately from depth.
64 direct providers with 7900-byte parameter names; selected source remains below 65536 bytes.

deterministic_assertions: Freeze generator, manifest, source snapshots, compiler C inputs, executable and runtime hashes before invoking any compiler.
Baseline/candidate runtime C and header bytes must match exactly; compiler flags are a declared build provenance requirement, not inferred from a binary.
Normal check and generated C outputs must agree byte for byte for both compilers on every fixed source.
Every sampled output must equal its preflight output; successful context output must repeat byte for byte.
Validate fixed schema limits, complete original selected source spans, row accounting and exact/bounded section evidence.

For geometric generated accepted context sources, selected lexical inspected_nodes must grow at most 2x plus 64 when size doubles; this asserts no bound on omitted descendant, checking, provider or type work.
Keep expected rejections as measured rows with diagnostics and no partial JSON, rather than filtering them out.
Verify all frozen input, generator, compiler and runtime identities before and after the run; keep failures and interruptions in the report.
